title: to recommend
text:
It was quite an experience. Doing yoga in the park is very nice, the wind, the blue sky, just everything has gone silent. It was also quite good practice and he corrects quite well. As in Spain, nobody is on time, but everyone stays longer 😅
really recommendable
author: jeryane

title: Great yoga class in nature
text: It was a wonderful experience, both for the class, which was masterful and for the environment. We will return soon to choose your services, we are delighted!
author: Luz42x

title: Yoga in the park
text: Nice yoga class of 1,5 hours in the shade in the most beautiful park. Some yoga mats provided by the instructor. For beginners and more experienced yogi’s.
author: Isabel_v

title: Don’t hastitate, just do it! You won’t regret!
text:
Yoga in the open air and in the parc was great. Hearing the birds, smelling the springflowers, between trees and on the grass, it made it really perfect. I ended really relaxed and very happy!
Khalma was great, he gave a really professional yoga. He had attention for everyone in the group and when needed he corrects you in your pose.
author: Linda_H

title: Amazing yoga in an amazing park!
text: Was a great setting in a beautiful park in the sun. Jesus, our instructor, was amazing and very supportive throughout - would highly recommend!
author: Matt_T

title: It was wonderful, thank...
text: It was wonderful, thank you! Also the environment in the park and the nature, just really beautiful:)
author: Angela_L

title: Yoga Bliss in Maria Luisa Park
text: I felt  so fortunate to find a yoga class in Maria Luisa park while on vacation in Seville.  The setting was beautiful and the yoga teacher , Jesus , was wonderful.  There was a sweet community of yogis in attendance from all over the world and we felt a strong sense of oneness with the guidance of Jesus.  The class was challenging but acceptable for beginners, the breath work was inspiring and both Spanish and English speakers could easily follow the flow. Simply delightful!!!
author: Becki_S

title: A wonderful yoga experience
text:
My partner practiced yoga in the park with Jesus for 3 weeks during our time in Seville. Jesus is a thoughtful and kind person and yoga teacher. We don't speak Spanish that well and he communicated with us via WhatsApp beforehand, making the booking process easy. Jesus conducts the classes in English and Spanish and it was easy to follow along. The classes are also great for all levels. I practice quite regularly, whereas my partner is a beginner. There were options throughout to suit every level, I even did my first head stand! 
I would highly recommend booking yoga in the park with Jesus.
author: emma p

title: Yoga and nature
text: Yoga classes with Jesus in Maria Luisa Park are a gift. From the first class, changes in the body and mind begin to be noticed. In addition, the teacher adapts the practice to different levels and does so in both Spanish and English. An activity to take care of yourself.
author: 518catim

title: Fantastic
text: I love Yoga classes in the Park, the instructor adapts to all levels and the feeling of doing it in a natural environment so grateful enriches the experience.
